entities.summary: Äli Äbdıkärımūly Bektaev is a Kazakh politician who has served as a Senator for Turkistan Region since 1 October 2014. From February 2006 to May 2008, he was the Äkim of Turkistan and continued serving as deputy until 2014. A member of the Auyl People's Democratic Patriotic Party, he served as its chairman from 2015 to 2023.
